messages:
jess_cs: quick alert 12 were seeing timeouts during Dedicated onboarding SSO handshakes in eu-west-1 starting ~10:40 UTC. active queue backing up; 5 high-touch accounts hit. need customer note + CSM playbook.
liam_eng: investigating. initial symptom: callback latencies spike when new GPU nodes initialize and the auth proxy drops early requests. grabbing logs now.
tasha_support: collecting affected tenant ids: acct-44, acct-77, acct-182, acct-191, acct-200. adding tickets and timezones.
jess_cs: thanks. primary objectives: 1) short public-facing status we can paste to tenants, 2) internal CSM script for renewals <45 days, 3) plan for credits + office hours.
reza_sales: for renewals <45d we should route to AMs and offer 10% credit plus 1:1 onboarding help. get list ASAP.
liam_eng: quick mitigation we can push: hold SSO callback retries locally with jittered backoff and route to warmed auth-proxy instances. will feature-flag to avoid global risk. canary deploy in 12m.
jess_cs: draft status (customer-facing):

"Hello — were aware some Dedicated onboarding attempts in eu-west-1 are failing at the SSO callback step. Our engineers have deployed a targeted mitigation and you may see intermittent retries while we validate. No action required from you. Well follow up with confirmation and a one-time account credit for affected customers. — Redwood CS"

tasha_support: add incident ref INC-5912 and a short line about expected window: "verification over next 60 minutes."
reza_sales: also include a note that high-touch customers will get a calendar invite for dedicated office hours to finish onboarding if needed.
liam_eng: canary metrics after 18m: failure rate down from ~22% to ~4% for acct-44/77. acct-182 shows token metadata mismatch; sending patch to decode older metadata formats.
jess_cs: perfect. CSM script bullets (internal):
- acknowledge issue + INC ref
- what were doing (mitigation + ETA 60m)
- offer credit (10% or prorated depending on contract)
- offer office hours (provide 2 slots)
- escalate to AM if renewal <45d

tasha_support: logging the office hours availability now. adding link to shared calendar: https://cal.redwood/workshop/ssoremedy (will confirm after scheduling).
liam_eng: rollback plan: toggle flag to route to pre-warmed proxy (instant) or revert patch. will keep monitor alarms enabled.
infra_bot: canary-deploy completed at 1899994200, metric: sso_callback_failure_rate=0.04, alert suppressed for 20m.
jess_cs: action list: 1) tasha  create/outbound status to affected tenants with the exact wording above + INC ref (now). 2) reza  compile renewal <45d list and prep AM outreach (ETA 2h). 3) liam  finish metadata patch for acct-182 and validate canary (ETA 45m). 4) jess  finalize credit amounts and CSM script, send to ops for approval (ETA 3h).
liam_eng: noted. will post final RCA + remediation summary here once patch validation completes.
tasha_support: outbound sent to tenants; snippet copied into INC-5912. customers told to expect follow-up and offered opt-in office hours.
reza_sales: compiling renewal-impact list now; will DM AMs and paste exec priority list after verification.
jess_cs: good work team. keep updates concise. Ill prepare an executive summary for the renewal ops meeting at 16:00 local. :white_check_mark:
